description: High-rigor 4-agent Double-Diamond brainstorming & discovery council combining Phase 0 Sponsor-User/System Audit, IBM Garage Hills & HMW framing, Silent 3-Lens Brainwriting + SCAMPER hybridization, David Bland Assumption Mapping Verification Gates, Empirical Verification Spikes, conditional Playback Gate, and Severity-Tiered Adversarial Red-Teaming.
name: Deep Discovery & Assumption-Mapped Brainstorm Council

roles.responsibilities: Frames strategic boundaries, measurable IBM Garage Hills, and HMW questions after Phase 0 Discover; synchronizes 3-lens parallel brainwriting; leads triage and SCAMPER hybridization into Top 2 contrasting finalists; synthesizes verified evidence and red-team findings into an executive Decision Matrix, Anti-Features register, and MVP roadmap; serves as sole external bridge.
roles.title: Strategy Facilitator & Synthesizer

roles.responsibilities: Generates 4 broad horizon sparks from a Concept, Experience & Architecture lens in Phase 1b; in Phase 3 deeply specifies both hybridized finalists with explicit proof of compliance against all Phase 2b Assumption Verification Gates.
roles.title: Creative Concept & Architecture Explorer

roles.responsibilities: Generates 3 sparks from a Systems, Performance & Data Mechanics lens in Phase 1b; performs rapid viability triage in Phase 2; executes empirical verification spikes (real runtime probes, headless browser/DOM checks when UI applies, load/complexity tests) answering every Phase 2b Verification Gate and mapping concrete file integration in Phase 3.
roles.title: Technical Feasibility & Verification Analyst

roles.responsibilities: Leads Phase 0 Sponsor-User & System Discover Audit (pain points, existing bugs, tooling baseline, system invariants); contributes CRI-1..3 sparks in Phase 1b; creates Top 5 High-Importance x Low-Evidence Verification Gates in Phase 2b; executes Phase 4 entry Verification Gate audit (issuing conditional PLAYBACK_HOLD only on gate failure) + ruthless [P0-BLOCKER]/[P1-RISK]/[P2-POLISH] red-teaming.
roles.title: Discover Auditor, Risk Mapper & Adversarial Critic

when_to_use: Best for complex existing applications, high-stakes product/UX redesigns, and deep architectural overhauls where hidden codebase bugs, operator friction, cross-layer invariants, and performance or UX assumptions must be audited upfront (Phase 0) and verified empirically through explicit Assumption Gates (Phase 2b) before shipping an implementation roadmap.
workflow_summary: 0. Critic audits live system/UX pain points & tooling -> 1. Lead frames IBM Hills/HMW & triggers 3-lens brainwriting (10 sparks) -> 2. Analyst triage & Lead SCAMPER Top 2 -> 2b. Critic maps Top 5 Assumption Verification Gates -> 3. Explorer specs & Analyst runs real empirical spikes per Gate -> 4. Critic audits Gates (conditional 1-turn PLAYBACK_HOLD if broken) + runs [P0]/[P1]/[P2] Red-Team -> 5. Lead delivers Hills Matrix, Anti-Features Register & MVP Roadmap.
